title: Steve Jobs Was No Straight A Student, But Having The Perfect Grades Isn't The Only Path To Build A $3.76 Trillion Company Like Apple
summary: Steve Jobs, co-founder of Apple, had a modest GPA of 2.65 as a high school student and left Reed College after one semester. Despite his academic record, Jobs' partnership with Steve Wozniak and his unique vision led to the creation of groundbreaking Apple products, contributing to the company's historic comeback and a $3.76 trillion market cap.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights Jobs' departure from traditional academic success and his significant impact on the tech industry, which is generally seen as negative due to the departure from the norm but positive due to his lasting influence on Apple's success.
